name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
free_tier: 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD, 1M TPM for Gemini 1.5 Flash. Generous free tier without credit card.
ideal_for: High-volume text generation, multilingual Gujarati analysis, vision understanding

name: Groq Cloud
free_tier: Ultra-fast LPU inference on Llama 3.3 70B, Mixtral 8x7b, Whisper. Up to 30 RPM and 14,400 RPD free.
ideal_for: Sub-second real-time crime audio transcription, classification, and reasoning

name: Hugging Face Inference API
free_tier: Free community serverless inference API across thousands of open models (IndicBERT, BERT, Sentence Transformers).
ideal_for: Indian language Gujarati embeddings, entity extraction, sentiment analysis

name: Cohere Trial API
free_tier: Free non-production trial keys with 100 API calls/minute for Command R+, Rerank, and Embed v3.
ideal_for: Semantic RAG re-ranking for intelligence crime feed search

name: Pinecone
free_tier: Serverless free tier with 2GB storage, up to 100,000 vectors with 100,000 read units/month.
ideal_for: Cross-lingual Gujarati/English crime similarity matching and deduplication

name: Qdrant Cloud
free_tier: 1 free 1GB cluster (up to ~1M vectors), persistent and perpetual without credit card.
ideal_for: District-filtered vector intelligence searches (e.g. filter by Veraval + vector search)

name: Weaviate Cloud (WCD)
free_tier: Free 14-day sandbox cluster (auto-expires unless renewed), or self-hosted open source.
ideal_for: Hybrid lexical + vector search (warning: sandbox is time-limited)

name: Supabase PostgreSQL
free_tier: 2 free projects, 500MB PostgreSQL DB with pgvector extension enabled, 1GB file storage, 50K monthly active users.
ideal_for: Full backend SQL storage with native pgvector search for cyber crime cases

name: Neon Serverless Postgres
free_tier: 0.5GB storage, 1 project with database branching, instant scale-to-zero, free forever without credit card.
ideal_for: Fast development environments and production PostgreSQL replica

name: MongoDB Atlas
free_tier: Shared M0 cluster with 512MB storage, replica set, SSL, vector search support, free forever.
ideal_for: Unstructured raw social media JSON payloads and telemetry archiving

name: Upstash Serverless Redis & QStash
free_tier: 10,000 commands/day for Redis, 500 messages/day for QStash message broker. Free forever.
ideal_for: Distributed rate limiting, session cache, and background job queuing

name: Render
free_tier: Free Web Services (512MB RAM, spins down after 15m inactivity, 750 free instance hours/month), free static sites, free SSL.
ideal_for: FastAPI backend and UI hosting for Gujarat Police portal

name: Cloudflare Pages & Workers
free_tier: Unlimited requests and bandwidth on static sites, 100,000 edge worker requests/day, free global CDN & SSL.
ideal_for: Zero-downtime frontend deployment and API reverse proxying

name: Vercel
free_tier: Hobby tier with 100GB bandwidth/month, unlimited serverless functions execution, free SSL and preview deployments.
ideal_for: React / Next.js frontend interfaces

name: Fly.io
free_tier: Free tier has been transitioned to prepaid trial credits; requires credit card verification.
ideal_for: Dockerized background workers (warning: requires CC on signup)

name: Cloudflare R2 Object Storage
free_tier: 10GB storage/month, 1 million Class A operations (writes), 10 million Class B operations (reads), ZERO egress fees.
ideal_for: Archiving social media video reels, FIR PDF dossiers, and crime screenshots with zero bandwidth fees

name: Backblaze B2
free_tier: 10GB free storage forever, 1GB free daily egress, S3 compatible API.
ideal_for: Police evidence backup repository without upfront payment

name: Clerk
free_tier: 10,000 monthly active users (MAUs), unlimited logins, MFA (TOTP/SMS), Google/GitHub OAuth, free SSL.
ideal_for: Investigating officer login, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), and biometric badge auth

name: Auth0 by Okta
free_tier: 7,500 active users, unlimited logins, 2 social identity providers, role-based access control (RBAC).
ideal_for: Government Single Sign-On (SSO) and officer role enforcement

name: Resend
free_tier: 3,000 emails/month (100 emails/day), custom domain support, DKIM/SPF verification, modern REST API.
ideal_for: Instant high-priority cyber alert emails to District Superintendents and PI officers

name: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue)
free_tier: 300 emails/day (9,000 emails/month) with unlimited contacts, SMTP relay and API.
ideal_for: High-volume statewide police dispatch notifications

name: Better Stack (Logtail & Uptime)
free_tier: 10 uptime monitors (3-minute checks), 1GB monthly logs with 3-day retention, email and push alerts.
ideal_for: Real-time uptime heartbeat monitoring for the Render deployment and RSS crawler health

name: Sentry Developer
free_tier: 5,000 error events/month, 10,000 performance transactions, 50 session replays for 1 member.
ideal_for: Zero-latency Python backend exception tracking and frontend JavaScript bug alerts
